info.title: Before You Buy an OTC Hearing Aid
info.subtitle: Five questions that matter more than the spec sheet

rows.title: Is your loss mild to moderate?
rows.desc: A hearing test tells you before you spend $799

rows.title: What does the price include?
rows.desc: Launch coverage lists $799 a pair. Remote sessions cost extra

rows.title: Who tunes the sound?
rows.desc: You do, in the app, unless you add remote audiology

rows.title: Where will you use Auracast?
rows.desc: Only venues that broadcast it. Those are still limited

rows.title: What are the return terms?
rows.desc: Launch coverage did not state them. Ask before you buy
